step1_figure.circuit_type: First-Stage Telescopic Differential Amplifier with Switched-Capacitor CMFB and Auto-Zero Reset Switches
step1_figure.description: Figure 26.54 shows the first-stage diff-amp with switched-capacitor common-mode feedback (SC-CMFB) using the biasing circuit from Fig. 26.52 and the SC CMFB block from Fig. 26.50. During phi1, transmission gates short the inputs to VCM and short the differential output nodes together, while during phi2 the SC CMFB circuit regulates the output common-mode level to Vbias1.

v_cm_out.description: Settled output common-mode voltage of the diff-amp (vopd and vomd)

equation.explanation: The SC-CMFB circuit compares the average of vopd and vomd to the target voltage Vbias1 and drives the tail MOSFET VCMFB to set the output common-mode level to Vbias1.
equation.assumptions: Periodic non-overlapping clocks phi1/phi2, loop has settled

sky130_expected.calculation: In SKY130 with VDD=1.8V, the PMOS cascode current mirror sets Vbias1 such that the upper PMOS devices operate in saturation. With VDD=1.8V, |Vthp|=0.42V, and Vovp~0.15V, Vbias1 settles near VDD - (|Vthp| + 2*Vovp) ~ 1.8 - (0.42 + 0.3) ~ 1.08V (or ~0.6V-0.9V depending on bias currents).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Vbias1 tracks the PMOS gate bias generated by the bias network in Fig 26.52 to ensure maximum output swing.

v_cmfb_settled.description: Steady-state control voltage VCMFB driving the second tail NMOS

equation.explanation: At common-mode equilibrium, the SC-CMFB output settles to Vbiasn so that both tail transistors (xm14 and xm15) carry equal shares of the tail bias current.
equation.assumptions: Symmetric differential pair and balanced load currents

sky130_expected.calculation: For SKY130 NMOS with Vthn=0.42V and Vovn~0.12V at 20uA, Vbiasn = Vthn + Vovn = 0.42 + 0.12 = 0.54V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Vbiasn is set by the Beta-Multiplier Reference (BMR) to establish ~20uA in an NMOS of size 10/1.

tail_current.description: Total quiescent tail current supplied to the diff-pair (xm14 + xm15)

equation.explanation: Two identical NMOS current sources biased by Vbiasn and VCMFB together supply the tail current of the input diff-pair.

sky130_expected.calculation: Each 10/1 NMOS tail transistor carries roughly 20 uA at nominal bias. Total Itail = 2 * 20 uA = 40 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Baker specifies drain currents of approximately 20 uA per device for 10/1 NMOS in this technology node.

equation.formula: A_{v,diff} = g_{m,in} \cdot R_{out} \approx g_{m,in} \cdot [(g_{m,casn} r_{on}^2) \parallel (g_{m,casp} r_{op}^2)]
equation.explanation: Telescopic cascode stage gain is the product of input transconductance and cascode output resistance.
equation.assumptions: All transistors in saturation during amplification phase phi2

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_in = sqrt(2 * unCox * (W/L) * ID) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 20u) = 329 uS. ro = 1/(lambda*ID) = 1/(0.1 * 20u) = 500 kOhm. gm_casn*ro^2 = 329u * (500k)^2 = 82.2 MOhm. gm_casp = sqrt(2 * 50u * 20 * 20u) = 200 uS. gm_casp*ro^2 = 200u * (500k)^2 = 50 MOhm. Rout = 82.2M || 50M = 31.1 MOhm. Av = 329u * 31.1M = 10,230 = 80 dB (realistically 50-70 dB due to submicron short-channel degradation).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode topology provides high output impedance, yielding typical gains of 50-70 dB in SKY130.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Unity gain frequency of the first stage with load/compensation capacitor Cc

equation.explanation: The gain-bandwidth product is determined by the input pair transconductance gm and the output load/compensation capacitance Cc = 50 fF.
equation.assumptions: Cc is 50 fF connected to outputs as indicated in Fig 26.54

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 329 uS, Cc = 50 fF. fun = 329e-6 / (2 * pi * 50e-15) = 1.05 GHz. Accounting for parasitic output capacitances (~25 fF total load ~75 fF): fun ~ 329e-6 / (2*pi*75e-15) ~ 700 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With 50 fF load capacitance and ~300 uS input transconductance, fun is in the hundreds of MHz to 1 GHz range.

power_dissipation.description: Total quiescent power consumption of diff-amp and biasing circuits

equation.explanation: Total static DC power consumed from the 1.8V rail across BMR, bias branch, and diff-amp branches.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current from VDD includes BMR (~80 uA), bias branch (~60 uA), and diff-amp (~40 uA), totaling ~180 uA. P = 1.8V * 180 uA = 324 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Multiple branches biased at ~20 uA each from 1.8V supply give total static power under 600 uW.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench measuring settled CMFB voltage, output common-mode voltage, tail current, and power dissipation of Fig 26.54 with 100 MHz non-overlapping clocks.
